name: Hibiki Nana
source:
A first-year student at Saika Girls' School. Yuka and Nana are classmates and live in the same dormitory.

Nana is a bright and energetic person who is always lively and cheerful. Despite her unlucky and unhappy nature, she never gives up and always wears a bright smile. In reality, however, Nana is lonely and loves to be spoiled.

She always carries an exorcism stick around her waist. When upset, she may swing the exorcism stick and shout to drive away evil spirits.
